---level11 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl10_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		dialog.show("~~~~~~", faceWeixiao)
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(280,707)
		sound.play("51-1")
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level10-1", faceBujie,0) ==1 then break end
		dialog.show("Level10-2", faceZhoumei)
		camera.gotoRole()
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl10_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false	

		isSkip = false
	until true
end


if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end
